d:
In this episode, we unravel the violent legacy of Bindy Johal, the poster boy of Indo-Canadian gang culture. From extortion and drug smuggling to nightclub shootouts, Bindy lived a life straight out of a gangster movie. He killed his own bosses, lived like a celebrity, and died at the hands of his own men at just 27. The violent legacy of Bindy Johal how a troubled teenager from Punjab became one of Canada's most feared gangsters and inspired the gangsters like Lawrence Bishnoi and Goldy Brar
Production: Anubhav Bajpai
Video Editor: Alok Sahu
